history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young person with curly black hair and glasses, wearing a black zip-up hoodie with a light purple cross pattern, black shorts, white socks with a black Nike logo, and white chunky sneakers, sits on a black metal chair. They are holding their glasses with their right hand, with several silver rings on their fingers. A silver cross pendant hangs from a chain around their neck. The background features a tiled floor, a trash can, tables and chairs in a dimly lit outdoor seating area of a restaurant, and a wall with a grid of purple-lit cubbies. The lighting is dim and atmospheric, with a strong purple hue from the wall cubbies casting shadows. The mood is casual and slightly edgy.
